2124552385372762512.en_summary: $QQQ hit its 100 week MA on Friday for the 1st time since the April 2025 crash low. It was down 10.5% this week, the biggest down week since the 2020 COVID bottom. Friday's low was probably a 16 week cycle low though a lower low next week is still possible.
2124552385372762512.zh_summary: $QQQ 於週五觸及 100 週移動平均線，為 2025 年 4 月崩盤低點以來首次。本週下跌 10.5%，為 2020 年 COVID 底部以來最大下跌週。週五低點可能是 16 週週期低點，但下週仍可能出現更低低點。
